subject: history

items.q: Did people understand and effectively treat the Black Death?
items.correct: No — its cause was unknown and treatments like bloodletting and prayer didn't work.
items.why: Without germ theory, responses were based on the Four Humours, miasma and religion.

items.q: What did people at the time think caused the Black Death?
items.correct: Many blamed God's punishment, bad air (miasma) or imbalances of the humours.
items.misconception: They knew it was spread by fleas on rats.
items.why: The true cause (a bacterium spread by fleas) was not understood at the time.
